faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Color Your Memories
faq.q1: What do I receive after placing an order?
faq.a1: You will receive a complete digital package: a Paint by Number Outline (PDF), a Custom Guangna Color Palette Guide with a Finished Artwork Impression (PDF). Please note: this is a custom digital artwork — no physical items will be shipped.
faq.q2: How long does it take to receive my custom Guangna-by-Number?
faq.a2: Once your payment is confirmed, you'll receive a delivery email from CreaBeaStudio with your download links—usually within 1 to 10 minutes.
faq.q3: What file formats can I upload?
faq.a3: We accept JPG, PNG, WEBP, and HEIC. Most phone photos work perfectly.
faq.q4: What kind of photo works best?
faq.a4: Use clear, high-resolution images with good lighting and subject in focus. Avoid blurry, dark, or heavily detailed photos. No screenshots or cropped pictures.
faq.q5: How long do you store my pictures?
faq.a5: Your files are securely stored for 37 days, then permanently deleted.
faq.q6: What skill level is this suitable for?
faq.a6: Our templates suit Beginner, Intermediate, and Advanced creators. If unsure, choose Intermediate — it's the best balance between detail and relaxing difficulty.
faq.q7: Why do you need to know which Guangna sets I own?
faq.a7: This lets us match every palette directly to the brush markers you have. You'll get combinations you can actually use right away, no guesswork, no missing colors.
faq.q8: Does Guangna by Number work with all Guangna markers?
faq.a8: It works with any of the sets listed right on our creation page! If you don't see your specific markers there, just drop us an email—we would be happy to add them for you.
faq.q9: My marker color doesn't match the palette guide?
faq.a9: Minor shade variations can occur due to ink batch differences, printing quality, or paper absorption. Your guide provides the best-match recommendation.
faq.q10: How do I print my coloring page?
faq.a10: Print at home or at a local print shop. Use thicker paper (160-200 gsm), print at 100% scale, designed for A4 or Letter size.
faq.a11: Due to the personalised digital nature of our products, refunds cannot be accepted once design work has started.
faq.a12: We specialise in custom coloring pages tailored specifically for Guangna brush markers — so you can start coloring immediately, without the time-consuming color selection task.

tips.title: Tips & Tricks
tips.subtitle: Color Your Memories
tips.s1a1: Shake the marker well and test until the ink flows evenly to avoid streaky lines. Gently press the nib on scrap paper until fully saturated. Never prime your markers directly on your coloring page, as this can cause large blobs and ruin a section.
tips.s1a2: Colors may appear differently on various surfaces. Do a quick test before starting your final piece.
tips.s2a1: At times, more than one color may be suggested for the same area. This is intentional — giving you the freedom to enhance detail, shading, and variation, while letting your creativity shape a beautiful final result.
tips.s2a2: Begin with lighter colors and gradually move to darker shades for better control and more natural blending.
tips.s2a3: Create smooth, clean lines using gentle pressure. Apply more pressure only for thicker strokes — avoid forcing the tip.
tips.s2a4: Build up color in layers, allowing each layer to dry. This creates richer tones, smoother coverage, and helps correct small mistakes.
tips.s2a5: Blend while the ink is still wet for soft gradients, or layer after drying for sharper contrast and definition.
tips.s2a6: Use white, lighter, or metallic tones on top to create highlights and achieve a more polished, professional finish.
tips.s2a7: Use a 3mm medium or chisel tip to quickly fill large background areas. Switch to a 0.7mm extra-fine tip for tight corners, small numbers, and intricate details.
tips.s2a8: Light colors like pastel pinks, yellows, and whites can be slightly transparent. Before coloring, tap a white acrylic marker over the printed number. Let it dry briefly to create an opaque base, then apply your chosen color on top.
tips.s2a9: If you color outside the lines, quickly wipe with a slightly damp tissue or cotton swab before the ink dries.
tips.s3a1: Wipe the tip occasionally to prevent color mixing and keep your shades crisp and precise.
tips.s3a2: Store markers horizontally to keep ink evenly distributed and ensure consistent flow.
tips.s3a3: Always close your markers immediately after use to prevent them from drying out.
tips.s3a4: If a marker feels dry, gently shake it and press the nib on scrap paper to reactivate the flow before use.

colorFamilyMethod.title: How the Color Families Are Created
colorFamilyMethod.intro: To build the most intuitive organization system possible, the color groupings were determined using a three-step process:
steps: Measurement: We recorded the color values and converted them into hue, saturation, and lightness (HSL) to mathematically analyze each shade.
Brand Context: We cross-referenced those values with the brands' original naming conventions/coding.
Visual Evaluation: Finally, we adjusted the order by eye.
colorFamilyMethod.closing: The resulting order is deliberately arranged to create a smooth, visually pleasing gradient rather than a forced, strictly mathematical layout. Because colors often sit naturally between two families (like a vibrant blue-green), they are included in both color families so you don't miss them.
colorFamilyMethod.tip: Think of these cards as a helpful, expert starting point — you can customize them to fit your own unique color interpretation!
colorFamilyMethod.note: Note: Metallic colors are not included in the color family grouping.
